_comment: AI 插画的画风，按主题匹配。illustrate.mjs 会把这里的描述、主题配色和底色一起拼进提示词。content.json 的 illustration.style 可以覆盖。
apple-hark: clean modern Apple-keynote style illustration, soft rounded 3D shapes, frosted glass accents, restrained palette of near-black white and apple blue, generous negative space, subtle soft shadows
apple-hark-dark: sleek dark-mode tech illustration, glowing accent lines and soft luminous shapes on a near-black ground, apple blue highlights, minimal and premium
apple-hark-warm: warm refined illustration on paper tones, soft rounded shapes, caramel terracotta and olive accents, calm editorial mood, gentle light
apple-flow: clean product-interaction illustration, iOS-style rounded shapes, strict 8pt grid, thin hairlines, one apple-blue accent on white, generous negative space, subtle soft shadow
hark-noir: isometric tech illustration on a deep navy ground, thin luminous blue lines, subtle grid, frosted glass surfaces, futuristic but clean
paper-editorial: refined editorial illustration for a business magazine, gouache texture, subtle grain, calm and intelligent mood, ink-black and brick-red accents
signal-swiss: minimal Swiss-style geometric illustration, flat shapes on a strict grid, ink black with a single signal-orange accent, bold and simple, lots of white space
